title: Lanterns Across the Marsh
narration: The stable beacon shines, and the neighbors begin the festival together. Every careful observation and shared task helped.

dialogue.text: This light belongs to the whole team.

ending.headline: A Radiant Festival
ending.summary: The lens was found, the beacon was repaired securely, and the neighbors returned together for the festival.

objectiveNotes.text: The missing lens was found at the boathouse.
The beacon received a stable repair.
The neighbors crossed the marsh together.

ending.reflection: Shared attention made the brightest light.
